greeting: BEHOLD! EL SCORCHO! THE INFERNO OF THE RING!
My flames burn eternal! My victories... also eternal!
El Verde sends you? The OLD champion? How... quaint.
Challengers? I EAT challengers! For BREAKFAST!
The mask hides nothing! The fire within SHOWS!
dialog.shop_open: Championship merchandise! Buy a piece of IMMORTALITY!
dialog.shop_prompt: Signed photos! Replica masks! Actual sweat! Limited supply!
haggle: GREATNESS has no price! But I'll take less!
For a FAN? Discount! Worship accepted as currency!
My time is VALUABLE! But you're PERSISTENT! Deal!
You drive a hard bargain! I RESPECT that!
purchase_success: TREASURE it! As I treasure VICTORY!
You now own GREATNESS! Display PROUDLY!
SMART! Very SMART! Like my moves!
rumor: El Verde? Once GREAT! Now? LESS great! But still RESPECTED!
Barrelman Bob challenged me once! Barrel wrestling! I WON! OBVIOUSLY!
The sign painter wants to paint my portrait! TOLD him! Too MUCH fire for canvas!
Deep-Dig Dan wants to wrestle underground! DARKNESS versus FIRE! I'd WIN!
dialog.quest_hook: Need a training opponent! Someone TOUGH! Bring me a SAND WYRM! ALIVE! I'll wrestle it! For TRAINING! Reward? WORTH it!
dialog.quest_active: Where's my WYRM? The CHAMPION waits!
dialog.quest_complete: MAGNIFICENT! The WRESTLE! The THRILL! Here! My SIGNATURE move! The SCORCHING SUPLEX! Learn it!
farewell: Tell them EL SCORCHO sent you!
dialog.time_dawn: Morning training! Pushups! ONE HANDED! While RECITING poetry!
dialog.time_noon: Peak HEAT! Peak POWER! I AM the SUN!
dialog.time_dusk: Evening matches! PRIME time! PRIME Scorcho!
dialog.time_night: Night training! In DARKNESS! To HONE the FLAMES!
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The WYRM-WRANGLER! My TRAINING partner SUPPLIER!
dialog.challenge_gesture: You! YES you! Think you can WRESTLE? Step INTO the ring!

party_reactions.kade: Oh man, I loved watching the fights back home!
party_reactions.twist: CAN I BE YOUR MANAGER?! PLEASE?!
party_reactions.renna: The mask is... actually quite well crafted.

relationship_dialog.stranger: New FAN! Welcome to the CHAMPION'S presence!
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: You RETURN! Drawn to GREATNESS! NATURAL!
relationship_dialog.friend: My LOYAL supporter! FRONT ROW seats for you!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You UNDERSTAND me! The FIRE! The PASSION! Brothers!

mini_quest.title: The Champion's Training
mini_quest.description: Capture a live sand wyrm for El Scorcho's training regimen

stages.hook: Need a TRAINING opponent! Someone TOUGH! Bring me a SAND WYRM! ALIVE! I'll wrestle it!
stages.active: Where's my WYRM? The CHAMPION waits! Big one! ANGRY one!
stages.complete: MAGNIFICENT! The BATTLE! The GLORY! Here! Learn my SIGNATURE MOVE! The SCORCHING SUPLEX! Use it WISELY!
